files.Title: NivalisModKit.CommandArgs
files.Summary: A dev command's arguments (?name=value&flag). Names ignore case.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Content.ItemSpec
files.Summary: What to change on a copied item. Anything left null keeps the template's value.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Content.RecipeSpec
files.Summary: What to change on a copied recipe. Anything left null keeps the template's value.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Content
files.Summary: Adds new things to the game: items and recipes, each made by copying an existing one and changing what you list. A copied item keeps its template's model, tags, decay and cooking use, so vendors that sell by tag stock it like its template. A copied recipe keeps its template's ingredient slots, processing and place in the unlock panel. Register in your plugin's Load, or ship a *.content.json file (see ).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ContentPacks.Pack
files.Summary: A content file that was read.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ContentPacks
files.Summary: Content without code: every *.content.json file under BepInEx\plugins (any subfolder) is read at startup and its items and recipes added through . Icon paths are relative to the file.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.DevCommands
files.Summary: Named commands that development tools can run in the game through the dev bridge (POST http://127.0.0.1:5710/cmd/name?arg=value, or tools/bridge.sh cmd name arg=value). For test mods and debugging: open a window, set up a situation, read back a result. Commands run on the main thread, so they can use the game and the kit freely. Running them needs the kit's [DevBridge] Enabled and AllowCommands; registering always works and costs nothing.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Economy
files.Summary: Vendors, prices, stock, and the player's money.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ExperimentalAttribute
files.Summary: Marks kit API that may change or be removed in a minor release, unlike the rest of the kit (see the README's Versioning section). Use it, but expect to update your mod when the kit updates.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.GameBuild
files.Summary: Which build of the game is running, and whether this kit was tested on it. The game's own version string stays "1.0" across patches, so the kit identifies the build by its code (a fingerprint of GameAssembly.dll).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.GameClock
files.Summary: The game clock's speed and pausing, shareable between mods. Each mod sets its own factor under its own owner name; the kit applies the product of all factors, so two mods that each want 2x get 4x, and removing one restores the other's. Factors survive save loads. Main thread only.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.GameEvents
files.Summary: Game events raised by the kit. Subscribe in your plugin's Load. An event whose patch failed to install never fires; check to degrade gracefully.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.GameTime
files.Summary: The game clock. Values are 0 before gameplay starts.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ItemArgs
files.Summary: Arguments for events about one item type (fish caught, crop planted).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Items
files.Summary: Item types: ingredients, dishes, equipment, furniture.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.KitPlugin.UntestedBuildMode

files.Title: NivalisModKit.KitPlugin

files.Title: NivalisModKit.KitWindow

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Layers
files.Summary: The game's rendering layers, by name. For cameras (cullingMask), raycasts and finding objects. Layers named CULL_n are props the game's own camera hides beyond n metres.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.MenuEntry
files.Summary: A dish on a venue's menu: see .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ModKit
files.Summary: Identity of the kit, for [BepInDependency] and version checks.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ModMenu.Page
files.Summary: A page a mod added to the browser.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ModMenu
files.Summary: The kit's "Mods" button in the pause menu, shared by every mod. Clicking it opens the mod browser: by default the kit's own, which lists each mod's settings and the pages mods add with . A mod can replace the browser with its own (). Main thread only.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ModSaveData
files.Summary: One mod's values in the current save. Get one from .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.ModSetting
files.Summary:
How a setting appears in the in-game mod browser. Pass one as a tag when you bind the setting:

Config.Bind("General", "Verbose", false,
    new ConfigDescription("Log every decision.", null, new ModSetting { IsAdvanced = true }));

Listing is opt-in: a setting appears when it has this tag, or when its mod called (then all of its settings appear, and these flags adjust them). The browser also reads BepInEx ConfigurationManager's ConfigurationManagerAttributes tag to adjust listed settings, but that tag alone doesn't list a setting.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.NativeHook
files.Summary: Native detours, for methods Harmony can't patch safely (by-ref struct parameters such as ShopTradeRequest or BasicTemp, where the IL2CPP trampoline passes garbage).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Navigation.Mesh

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Navigation

files.Title: NivalisModKit.OrderInfo
files.Summary: A customer order waiting to be filled: see .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Photo

files.Title: NivalisModKit.PhotoResult
files.Summary: A picture from , and how it maps onto the world.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Place
files.Summary: A place in the loaded scene: see .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.PlaceKind
files.Summary: Kinds of place the game's compass can point at.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Player
files.Summary: The player in the world: where they are and where they're looking.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Pricing
files.Summary: Change vendor prices. Handlers adjust ; the result is what the shop shows and what is actually charged or paid, for the player and for venue managers alike. Nothing is installed until a mod subscribes. Prices are recalculated on every lookup, so a handler can change its rules at any time (for example from a live-reloaded setting).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.PurchaseResult
files.Summary: What the pipeline did with one vendor offer.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Purchasing
files.Summary: Manager ingredient purchasing. Once any mod subscribes to or , the kit takes over each recipe's purchases: it collects the vendor offers the game makes, lets handlers set the quantity and the vendor order, then buys only up to that quantity, stopping at the first failed purchase (almost always the venue out of money). With no subscribers the kit leaves purchasing to the game.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.SaveData
files.Summary: Data that belongs to one save, stored next to it as <save>.modkit.json. Values are kept per mod and per key, as JSON. Read and set them any time during gameplay; the kit writes the file when the game saves and reads it back when that save loads. A new game starts empty.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Scenes
files.Summary: The loaded scenes and what's in them.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Scheduler
files.Summary: Run code later, on the main thread: next frame, after some game time, at a clock hour, or after some days. Game-time schedules are checked every frame against the clock, so sleeping past the moment still runs them (once, when the clock passes it). Everything pending is cancelled when a save loads or a new game starts; keep longer plans in .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Staff
files.Summary: Task priority for characters, staff included. Each character (Person) points to an ActionPriorityList asset: an ordered list of the actions it considers, first = most important. Game patch 2 (October 2, 2026) set the staff order to serve, process ingredient, make meal, take order, deliver, buy, manage complaint, cleanup meal, cleanup trash, cleanup storage.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Stall
files.Summary: A vendor's stall in the loaded scene: see .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.StructLayout
files.Summary: Field offsets and sizes of IL2CPP types, read from the running game, for code that works with raw pointers (see ). Results are cached.

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Tuning
files.Summary: Change game rules: crop yield and growth speed, fish yield, property prices, security awareness gain. Each is an event whose handlers adjust a value; nothing is patched until a mod subscribes to that event. Handlers run in the order added, each seeing the previous one's value; one that throws is logged and skipped. For vendor prices see .

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Ui
files.Summary: The game's UI: which screens are open, and the game's own notifications and dialogs. Screens are UIPanel MonoBehaviours placed in the scene (prefabs), shown and hidden by the game; and report them. Call these from the main thread (event handlers, Update, the Scheduler).

files.Title: NivalisModKit.VendorOffer

files.Title: NivalisModKit.Venues
files.Summary: Venues: restaurants, bars and shops the city's managers run, the player's included.
